# Kusalacittakathā (Kv 22.2)

**ID:** Kv 22.2
**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Kusalacittakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m3.mul29.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 In secondary scholarship, the term *kusalacitta* commonly appears as a general Abhidhamma technical category denoting wholesome consciousness; in reference to Kathāvatthu debates, Nalinaksha Dutt notes that the Theravādins debated the Andhakas regarding the status of the arahant, including the claim that an arahant accumulates merit and passes away with wholesome consciousness (*kusalacitta*) [Dutt 1978].
